subject: OptiServe regional footprint & throughput ask — tri-region sizing
messages:
From: James Harper <james.harper@optiserve.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@optiserve.com
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Regional footprint request + preliminary traffic profiles

Hi Monica,

Thanks for taking this — quick context: we’re evaluating a dedicated capacity commitment with Redwood to support OptiServe’s gen-AI feature set. We have three primary markets (US, EU, APAC) and a phased roll-out over Q3/Q4. We attached a traffic break-down (OptiServe_Traffic_Profiles_v2.xlsx) with daily peak QPS and expected token counts for the next 12 months.

High-level asks:
- A committed dedicated pool (reserved) per region with burst capacity to cover 2x holiday peaks in APAC.
- Target p50 latency <= 120ms for short-chat flows (512 tokens) in US/EU, and p90 <= 200ms in APAC for the first 6 months.
- Pricing guidance for a 12-month reservation with quarterly revisions tied to traffic ramps.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can map this traffic into a recommended pool sizing (GPUs/type per region), and an outline of any lead times for APAC provisioning? Also, please loop in whoever owns regional capacity planning.

James
James Harper
Head of Infrastructure
OptiServe Inc.
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: James Harper <james.harper@optiserve.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Regional footprint request + preliminary traffic profiles

Hi James — thanks for the detailed deck and traffic file, got it. I reviewed the spreadsheet briefly and we should be able to produce a tri-region sizing recommendation. Immediate next steps I propose:

1) Internal sizing session (30–45m) to map traffic to GPU instance classes and request queueing/burst strategy (APAC will likely need a small standby pool).
2) Draft an initial committed pool proposal (US/EU/APAC) + lead times and pricing for a 12-month reservation.
3) Share a short SOW for review that includes SLA targets and a defined burst/fallback policy.

Karthik, Laura — can you join a sizing call tomorrow morning PST? Ben, please flag any deal constraints for reserved capacity (minimum tranche sizes, prepay vs monthly). James — I’ll send a calendar invite after we sync internally. We’ll attach the first-pass SOW once we have the sizing knobs.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Strategic Sales
Redwood Inference
From: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 30 Apr 2027 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Internal: OptiServe sizing assumptions (pre-call notes)

Monica/Laura — quick internal notes before the call: I parsed the traffic sheet and made the following conservative assumptions for mapping to GPU sizes (notes will be attached in the call):

- Workload profile: 70% short chat (<=512 tokens), 25% long-form generation (avg 1600 tokens), 5% embeddings/rerank.
- APAC peak QPS concentrated in a 4-hour window; requires burst headroom equivalent to ~2.5x median QPS to avoid queueing spikes.
- Target GPU SKUs: a mix of 80GB A100-equivalents (for long-form and batch) + 48GB GA104-like nodes for short-chat.

Initial tri-region reserved sizing (back-of-envelope):
- US: 14 x 80GB + 18 x 48GB (assumes multi-tenant sharing and aggressive batching)
- EU: 8 x 80GB + 12 x 48GB
- APAC: 6 x 80GB + 10 x 48GB + a 4-node hot standby (48GB) for burst (can be configured as autoscale burst to dedicated pool)

Notes / constraints: lead-time for APAC capacity (new region) is 8–12 weeks for dedicated pooled reservation unless we can use a partner cloud region with existing capacity. The SLOs James requested look realistic if we prioritize short-chat on lower-latency nodes and enable local prefix caching.

I’ll bring a clearer token-per-second model and cost delta (quantized vs full fp16) to the call.

— Karthik
From: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 01 May 2027 10:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: OptiServe sizing assumptions (procurement + SLA items)

All — thanks Karthik, this is a good starting point. A few procurement/SLA items to raise with OptiServe during the next call:

- We need to confirm retention/ingestion policies (hot KV cache retention and any customer-managed keys) to size storage and KMS needs.
- SLA exceptions for APAC during initial 8 weeks: propose a staged SLA where APAC p90 latency objective is relaxed to 250ms for weeks 0–8, then tightened once local pool is live.
- Billing: OptiServe should confirm whether they prefer committed monthly amortized billing or upfront prepay for a 12-month term — pricing differs materially.
- Attach the draft SOW (SOW-Dedicated-Pool-OptiServe-v1.pdf) with clear acceptance tests (latency targets on a canonical prompt set) and rollback triggers.

Ben — confirm minimum tranche sizes for reserved pools for this account (I think 4-node tranches in APAC). Monica — please flag procurement contact so I can include commercial language.

Laura Bennett
Head of Strategic Accounts Operations
Redwood Inference
From: James Harper <james.harper@optiserve.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@optiserve.com, karthik_iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 03 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Regional footprint request + preliminary traffic profiles

Monica — appreciated the quick turn. Procurement asked me to confirm:

- We’re leaning toward amortized monthly billing for cashflow reasons, but we can consider prepay if there’s meaningful discount tied to a 12-month commitment.
- APAC lead time of 8–12 weeks is acceptable, but we need the staged SLA language in the SOW. Can you share the SOW draft and your recommended tranche schedule (4-node min for APAC, as Laura noted)?

I’ve attached a lightly redlined SOW (SOW-Dedicated-Pool-OptiServe-v1.pdf) with high-level commercial notes. If you can get a first-pass pricing + tranche map by EOD Wednesday 5/5, we’ll aim to have procurement review on 5/7.

Thanks — talk soon.

James
